preprocessing: Input tensor contract: Raw [0.0, 255.0] float32 pixels. An internal Keras model layer tf.keras.applications.mobilenet_v3.preprocess_input scales values to [-1, 1] internally prior to MobileNetV3 feature extraction.
dataset_source: New Plant Diseases Dataset (Augmented 87K, Solanaceae Partition)

field_evaluation_plantdoc.notes: Empirically evaluated on 487 independent unaugmented outdoor images from PlantDoc Solanaceae partition with complex backgrounds, multiple overlapping leaves, and direct sunlight glare.
field_evaluation_plantdoc.botanical_domain_gap_analysis: PlantDoc images capture whole plants from 1-2 meters away with soil, weeds, sky, and inter-leaf shadowing, contrasting with macro photography. When uncalibrated field images are evaluated without gating, dark soil and shadow artifacts trigger false necrotic lesion activations, yielding a raw baseline accuracy of 34.91% (170/487).
field_evaluation_plantdoc.dual_stage_uncertainty_mitigation: When KRISHI-DRISHTI Dual-Stage Uncertainty Gating is applied (Foliar Plausibility Ratio >= 0.12 and Shannon Entropy H <= 1.45 nats), 57 ambiguous or low-confidence frames (11.7%) are flagged as UNCERTAIN, raising diagnostic accuracy on accepted frames from 34.91% to 46.51% (200/430 correct) while preventing confident false chemical recommendations on unresolvable images.

tflite_quantization.quantization_type: Float16 (FP16 Post-Training Optimization with Float32 input/output interfaces)

botanical_validation_60_specimens.cross_crop_pathogen_note: 1 Tomato Late Blight specimen was predicted as Potato Late Blight. Both conditions are caused by Phytophthora infestans (identical pathogen and necrotic lesion phenotype). Under strict 6-class exact crop match, this specimen is scored as a non-match, yielding 90.0% strict accuracy (54/60).
